programs.name: Summer Internship Program in Biomedical Research (SIP)
programs.focus: The largest biomedical summer research program in the country. One application reaches hundreds of NIH intramural labs across every institute, including NICHD (pediatrics), NINDS (neuro) and NCI (cancer).
programs.stipend_note: Set by NIH each year by education level; the page posts no figure

eligibility.notes: US citizens or permanent residents, enrolled at least half time. Must be 17 by program start.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the application is open now and closes Tuesday, Jan 26, 2027 at 12 p.m. noon ET. Letters are due Tuesday, Feb 2 at noon ET. There is no central selection: individual NIH investigators pick their own interns and start interviewing in early January, so emailing NIH PIs whose work you like is part of applying, not an extra. Bethesda is a commute from Leesburg, which is why no housing does not matter here.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.
programs.program_dates: Between May 10 and Aug 31, 2027, dates set with your PI

programs.name: Amgen Scholars Program (US)
programs.city: Multiple (Caltech, Columbia, Duke, Harvard, Howard, Hopkins, Stanford, UC Berkeley, UCLA, UCSF, UNC, UT Southwestern, WashU, Yale)
programs.focus: Premier national undergraduate research program with a shared symposium; each host institution runs its own application and its own labs.
programs.stipend_note: Varies by host. Travel and room and board at the July symposium are covered

eligibility.notes: Sophomores, juniors, or non-graduating seniors at accredited four-year schools. Minimum 3.2 cumulative GPA. Oriented toward students interested in a PhD or MD-PhD.

programs.notes: BEST VALUE PER UNIT OF EFFORT. You can apply to as many US hosts as you like, and most of the essay is reusable. Each host runs its own application and opens it on its own schedule. One host is Howard University in Washington, which you could do from home. CONFIRMED on the page: Feb 1, 2027 for every US host. About 140 scholars a year across 14 hosts.
programs.program_dates: Varies by host, roughly May 17 - Aug 27, 2027

programs.name: Summer Student Program (SSP)
programs.city: Bar Harbor, ME and Farmington, CT
programs.focus: Ten weeks of genetics and genomics research with an independent project and a written report, unusually strong mentorship structure.
programs.stipend_note: $7,500 plus room, board and travel at Bar Harbor; Farmington is not residential

eligibility.notes: High school seniors and undergraduates. Deadline is 5:00 p.m. ET.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 2, 2026 and due Jan 25, 2027 at 5 p.m. ET. The best total package on this list. Bar Harbor is residential and Farmington is not, so Bar Harbor is the safer pick. Virtual open houses Dec 8, Dec 14 and Jan 5.
programs.program_dates: Bar Harbor Jun 5 - Aug 13, 2027; Farmington May 31 - Aug 8, 2027

programs.name: Summer Research Early Identification Program (SR-EIP)
programs.city: Multiple member institutions (Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Harvard, Hopkins, Yale, Vanderbilt and more)
programs.focus: One application, many elite host institutions, plus a national research symposium at the end of the summer.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus travel and housing from the host institution

eligibility.notes: For students committed to a PhD or MD-PhD; the program says it is not designed for clinical medicine careers. At least two semesters done and one left when summer starts.

programs.notes: The portal is open now. One application ranks three of the 20 host sites, 8 to 10 weeks depending on the site. Howard University in Washington is the only host you could commute to. Johns Hopkins is not a 2027 host.

programs.name: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP)
programs.org: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
programs.focus: Nine weeks of genomics, cancer and neuroscience research at one of the strongest genomics institutes in the world.
programs.stipend_note: $5,400 plus housing, travel to Boston, and a conference trip to present your work

eligibility.notes: Free for all nine weeks with no other courses or job. You must graduate December 2027 or later and be aiming at a PhD or MD/PhD.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open since Oct 26, 2026, closes Jan 10, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. ET, letters due Jan 11. The statement is five short essays, not one. Decisions by mid-March.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.focus: Independent research in basic and cancer biology at Fred Hutch.
programs.stipend_note: $7,304 before taxes, plus up to $450 travel. Housing is yours, about $3,400 at UW

eligibility.notes: For students entering the summer before their final year, which is you.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, due Friday, Jan 8, 2027 at midnight Pacific, which is 3 a.m. Eastern on Jan 9. Letters are due Jan 15. Decisions by mid-March. Submit early: the page warns the portal can fail under last-minute uploads and late work is not accepted.

programs.name: Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
programs.focus: Ten fully subsidized weeks of research at a legendary molecular biology institute, ending in a formal presentation.
programs.stipend_note: $7,000 with room and board on campus; travel is yours

eligibility.notes: Sophomores and juniors. No minimum GPA, though successful applicants usually have about 3.5 in science and math. Official transcripts are not required.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, and completed applications, letters included, are due Jan 15 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific, which is 2:59 a.m. Eastern on Jan 16. About 20 students a summer. Bench science, not clinical.

programs.name: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
programs.focus: Nine weeks of research in MIT labs with heavy graduate-school preparation.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus housing, travel and meal allowance

eligibility.notes: Oriented toward students planning a PhD.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: apply by Jan 19, 2027. Stipend, housing and eligibility details are on the separate Application page, so confirm them there.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of bench research at a pure-research biomedical institute with an excellent mentoring reputation.
programs.stipend_note: $6,500, with free housing if you cannot commute
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: due Feb 1, 2027. About 25 of more than 700 applicants are accepted. Decisions in mid-March.

programs.name: REU Sites: Biological Sciences (search portal)
programs.focus: The master index of NSF-funded Research Experiences for Undergraduates. Each site applies separately; stipends are standardized and housing is usually covered.

eligibility.notes: NSF REUs require US citizenship or permanent residency. Most exclude graduating seniors.

programs.notes: Not one program but a portal to hundreds. Filter by Biological Sciences and by state. Deadlines run from December to March, so check it monthly. Housing and travel are usually covered, which makes REUs cheaper than many hospital programs.

programs.name: Pathways to Science: summer research database
programs.focus: The best free aggregator of funded undergraduate summer research programs, searchable by discipline and deadline.
programs.notes: Use this as a monthly sweep to catch programs this list does not have. Sort by deadline.
